metadata.title: Digital Service Standards Control Catalog - Understand Users

props.name: keywords
props.value: IM8, GovTech, Singapore, digital service standards, Understand Users

props.name: rationale
props.value: Understanding end user context, goals, behaviour and mindsets allows you to design solutions that truly meet their needs. Better-aligned digital services effective meet user needs from the start, improving user satisfaction, and reducing costly rework.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Understand and document Public Users' needs and context when creating a new digital service, redesigning existing services or introducing major features.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Take steps to understand end user context, needs, and problems before deciding on a solution.
This includes activities such as:
a) conducting user research (e.g. surveys, interviews, ethnographic studies)
b) analysing end user feedback
c) using web analytics and other relevant data.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Testing with end users allows early identification of usability issues at various points in the design and development process. This ensures the product is intuitive and usable, and reduces the risk of costly fixes later.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Conduct and document usability testing with representative Public Users when creating a new digital service, redesigning existing services or introducing major features. Remediate or risk accept findings within {{ insert: param, uu-2_prm_1 }} day(s).

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Conduct usability testing at key milestones such as prior to public release. Identify key end user tasks based on real scenarios and create prototypes to test them.
Document findings in a structured report, prioritising issues based on severity.
While structured usability testing is recommended, lightweight methods—such as guerrilla testing with a small number of users—are acceptable if they still yield actionable insights.
Usability testing is not user acceptance testing.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days to remediate or risk accept findings.
